Int. Cl. C01B 33/20 (2006.01); H01J 37/32 (2006.01)
CPC C01B 33/20 (2013.01) [C01P 2002/60 (2013.01); C01P 2002/72 (2013.01); C01P 2002/74 (2013.01); C01P 2004/03 (2013.01); C01P 2004/61 (2013.01); C01P 2006/90 (2013.01); H01J 37/32495 (2013.01)] 20 Claims
 
1. A composite structure comprising: a base material; and a structure provided on the base material and has a surface,
wherein the structure comprises Y2SiO5 crystal as a main component and lattice constants of the crystal satisfy at least one of a>9.06 Å, b>6.93 Å, and c>6.70 Å.
 
10. A composite structure comprising: a base material; and a structure provided on the base material and has a surface,
wherein the structure comprises Y2SiO5 crystal as a main component, and an peak intensity ratio (300)/(121) which is the ratio of (300) peak to (121) peak in X-ray diffraction of the crystal, is greater than 100%.
 
19. A composite structure comprising: a base material; and a structure provided on the base material and has a surface,
wherein the structure comprises Y2SiO5 crystal as a main component, and has an indentation hardness of more than 7.5 GPa.
